title: Two-stage risk-averse objective
description: x: first-stage capacities shared by all scenarios; y_s: scenario dispatch; A_k annualised cost (annuity + fixed O&M, kEUR/unit-yr); w = TΔt/8760 scales annual costs to the horizon; π_s scenario probability; λ risk weight; α CVaR confidence level.

title: Scenario operating cost
latex: L_s = \sum_{t} \Delta t\,\big(p^{m}_{s,t} m_{s,t} - \rho\,p^{m}_{s,t} y_{s,t} + \mathrm{VOLL}\,u_{s,t} + c^{h} h_{s,t} + c^{\deg} d_{s,t}\big)
description: Import cost minus export revenue (export price = ρ × import price), unserved-energy penalty, hydro variable O&M, battery throughput degradation proxy.

title: CVaR linearisation (Rockafellar–Uryasev)
description: ζ is the Value-at-Risk at the optimum; CVaR is the expected loss in the worst (1−α) probability tail.

title: Hourly energy balance
description: Curtailment is implicit: g ≤ available, so curtailed energy = available − g and is not double counted. The dual of this constraint is the system marginal cost.

title: Variable renewable availability
latex: 0 \le g^{pv}_{s,t} \le f^{pv}_t\, x_{pv},\qquad 0 \le g^{w}_{s,t} \le f^{w}_t\, x_{w}
description: f: hourly capacity factors derived from NASA POWER irradiance, temperature and 50 m wind speed.

title: Reservoir water balance
latex: V_{s,t+1} = V_{s,t} + \Delta t\,\big(I_{s,t} - h_{s,t}/\kappa - \sigma_{s,t}\big),\quad V^{\min} \le V_{s,t} \le x_{vmax}
description: V in hm³; I inflow, σ spill (hm³/h); κ = ρ g H η · 10⁶ / 3.6·10⁹ MWh/hm³ (fixed-head linearisation, H = 230 m, η = 0.88 → κ ≈ 551.6).

title: Turbine, environmental release and terminal conditions
latex: 0 \le h_{s,t} \le P^{h},\quad h_{s,t}/\kappa + \sigma_{s,t} \ge r^{\min},\quad V_{s,0}=V^0,\; V_{s,T} \ge V^{T}
description: Annual runs: V^T = V^0 closes the seasonal cycle. Short windows: V^0 and V^T are taken from a coarse annual run of the same scenario (nested boundary).

title: Run-of-river hydro
description: Availability from the reconstructed inflow index; no storage.

title: Battery state of charge
latex: e_{s,t+1} = e_{s,t} + \Delta t\,\big(\eta^{c} c_{s,t} - d_{s,t}/\eta^{d}\big),\quad \varepsilon\, x_{be} \le e_{s,t} \le x_{be},\quad 0\le c_{s,t},d_{s,t} \le x_{bp}
description: Independent power (MW) and energy (MWh) sizing; e_0 = s_0 x_be and e_T ≥ e_0. Simultaneous charge/discharge is not excluded by binaries; a throughput cost removes the incentive and it is monitored ex post.

title: Aggregate interconnection
description: a_s: scenario availability of the net transfer capacity. Not an AC power-flow model.

title: Unserved energy
description: Shortage is always feasible but penalised at VOLL, so scarcity is visible rather than hidden.

title: Capital budget and investment bounds
latex: \sum_{k} C_k (x_k - x_k^0) \le B,\quad x_k^0 \le x_k \le x_k^0 + \bar{x}_k,\quad x_{be} \le \delta^{\max} x_{bp}
description: C_k overnight capital cost (kEUR/unit), B budget (MEUR), δ^max maximum battery duration (h).

title: Annualisation
description: r real discount rate, n_k lifetime (years), f_k fixed O&M share of capex per year.

title: Marginal value of flexibility
description: From the reduced cost d̄_k of the fixed capacity variable. Because the LP value function is piecewise linear and convex in x_k, the dual is a subgradient lying between the right (Δ⁺) and left (Δ⁻) finite-difference values; it is valid only locally and may be non-unique under degeneracy.
